message.reasoning:
The user says "start Docker on window using docker start." They want to start Docker on Windows using docker start. But docker start is used to start containers, not the Docker daemon itself. To start Docker service, you need to start the Docker Desktop or Docker Engine service. On Windows, you can use PowerShell: Start-Service Docker. Or if using Docker Desktop, you might need to launch Docker Desktop app. The user likely wants to start Docker engine via command line. So we should explain that docker start starts containers, not the Docker daemon. To start Docker service, use Start-Service Docker. Also ensure Docker Desktop is installed. Provide command: powershell -Command "Start-Service Docker". Or use sc start Docker.

We have a tool to execute commands. We can call functions.cmd_controller_execute with command "powershell -Command \"Start-Service Docker\"" or "sc start Docker". Let's choose "powershell -Command \"Start-Service Docker\"".

But we need to consider that the user might want to start Docker Desktop. That requires launching the application. But we can't do that via command line easily. However, we can start the Docker Desktop service via "Start-Service com.docker.service" maybe. Actually Docker Desktop runs as a service named "com.docker.service". So we can start it: Start-Service com.docker.service. But the standard Docker service name is "Docker Desktop Service" or "com.docker.service". Let's check typical names: On Windows, Docker Desktop installs a service called "com.docker.service". So we can start it: Start-Service com.docker.service. Alternatively, "sc start com.docker.service".

Thus we can provide both options. We'll use "powershell -Command \"Start-Service com.docker.service\"" to start Docker Desktop. Then we can confirm it's running. We can also mention that docker start is for containers.
